title: Template-Based Probes Are Imperfect Lenses for Counterfactual Bias Evaluation in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) disparities in sentiment classification using counterfactual template-based probes (Amazon, NS-Prompts, and Regard datasets). The text varies racial group descriptors and evaluates outputs using both fine-tuned and zero/few-shot prompted LLMs.

Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) gaps in sentiment classification using zero-shot and few-shot prompted LLMs on counterfactual template-based probes from the Amazon dataset with varying sexual orientation descriptors.

Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) gaps in sentiment classification using zero-shot and few-shot prompted LLMs on counterfactual template-based probes from the Amazon dataset with varying gender identity descriptors.
